def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # sign errors in flipper length: lengths can't be negative
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce').abs()
    # body mass unit/scale errors: values far above the plausible max are 1000x too large
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    while mask.any():
        df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000.0
        mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    # normalize sex label variants (extra spaces / case); missing stays missing
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype('object').where(df['sex'].notna(), None)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].apply(lambda v: v.strip().lower() if isinstance(v, str) else v)
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    g = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
